title: Fidelity Sherpa: Automated calibration sweep + gating for FP8/INT8 rollouts
creator: Ava Patel
description: Goal: Build 'Fidelity Sherpa', an automated harness that runs calibration sweeps for FP8/INT8 model variants, evaluates accuracy across multiple signal families, and emits pass/fail gates integrated with the rollout controller. The harness should: (1) orchestrate per-layer and per-block calibration profiles, (2) run stochastic calibration permutations (random seeds / clip ranges / per-channel vs per-tensor), (3) select veracity anchors (a dynamic golden set) per workload cohort, (4) compute composite fidelity metrics (semantic similarity, log-prob divergence, token-level edit distance, behavior tests), and (5) produce deterministic gate decisions surfaced to Console rollouts and the canary pipeline. Unique requirements: - Dynamic golden curation: golden prompt candidates are sampled from production traffic cohorts and weighted by rarity and semantic coverage to avoid stale hand-curated sets. - Composite metric & policy: a tunable policy that combines semantic delta (BERTScore or SBERT cosine), distributional divergence (KL / JS on token log-probs), and functional tests (pass/fail behavioral checks). Each metric has configurable tolerances and per-route weighting. - Failure modes & remediation: when a gate fails, the controller should either: revert to FP32 baseline, route traffic to a higher-precision variant, or fall back to cached responses for matched golden prompts. - Telemetry & explainability: persist per-prompt diffs, per-layer sensitivity map, and top-10 failure examples to the Console for debugging. - Isolation & reproducibility: harness runs must be seedable and record the exact quant config (per-layer bitwidths, clipping params, calibration samples) to the audit log for Private deployments. Integration points: - Console rollouts (for gating signals) - Optimize recommendations engine (to surface quant profile suggestions) - Calibration dataset store (S3) and evaluation infra (k8s job runner) Non-goals: model training changes, manual golden list maintenance.
acceptance_criteria: Harness can run end-to-end calibration sweep and emit a JSON gate decision for a model variant within the CI job
Composite fidelity score computed and stored in the evaluation DB for each candidate variant
Console shows per-route gate status and top-10 counterexamples within 60s of job completion
Canary rollout integrates gate decision: failing variant is not promoted; passing variant can be auto-promoted per policy
Reproducible runs: a run id maps to identical inputs, seeds, and quant params and reproduces the same composite score
Automated threshold tuning: run with historical golden cohorts yields expected false-positive rate <= 2% after initial calibration
